report:
2.7.0.Final generates new schemas with changed field types

Hi!
We upgraded our Oracle Debezium connector in our dev environment from 2.6.2.Final to 2.7.0.Final.
After the upgrade we encountered problems in some downstream applications due to the connector changing the datatype of some fields from int to double even though there has been no change to the underlying table column datatypes.
Is there any particular reason for this change?

evidence.quote: What you are likely seeing is changes related to DBZ-7882. We documented this breaking change in 2.7.0.Beta1

notes: int to double schema change after upgrade looks like a regression but is the intended, documented fix honoring decimal.handling.mode=double.
